title: 1.2.8 Media Alternative (Prerecorded) mini-assessment
description: Complete after the required lesson activity.

elements.name: q_1
elements.title: What media types does 1.2.8 cover?
choices: Prerecorded synchronized media and prerecorded video-only media
elements.correctAnswer: Prerecorded synchronized media and prerecorded video-only media
elements.explanation: The criterion explicitly covers synchronized and video-only prerecorded media.

elements.name: q_2
elements.title: Why can a speech-only transcript be incomplete?
choices: It may omit meaningful visual actions and results
elements.correctAnswer: It may omit meaningful visual actions and results
elements.explanation: The alternative must convey relevant visual and audio information.

elements.name: q_3
elements.title: What about interactive opportunities in the original media?
choices: Provide a means to achieve equivalent interaction as required by the definition
elements.correctAnswer: Provide a means to achieve equivalent interaction as required by the definition
elements.explanation: The definition addresses opportunities to achieve the same interaction.
